name: TrueWood Lite Natural Oak Slats, Oatmeal Felt
summary: Solid rubberwood slats wrapped in real natural oak veneer on three sides, stapled to oatmeal acoustic felt.

texture.note: Manufacturer spec sheet overrides photo estimates: 8 rectangular 27 mm oak-veneered slats with 10.5 mm exposed felt gaps on a 37.5 mm pitch, 5 mm slats over 5 mm felt (10 mm total); the installed panel repeat is 300 mm, not the 305 mm end-to-end width. This 300 x 600 mm seamless tile uses pale natural oak tones sampled from main.jpg and warm oatmeal felt, with subtle softened edges and procedural, vertically wrapping grain.
